LanguageData.EndIt_Desc: {0} has had enough. They will turn their {1} on themselves.\n\nThe wound will be severe, but it is not guaranteed to be fatal.
LanguageData.EndIt_Confirm: Are you sure you want {0} to end it with their {1}?\n\nThis cannot be undone.
LanguageData.EndIt_NoWeapon: No gun or blade on {0} or within reach.
LanguageData.EndIt_MentalState: {0} is not in control of themselves.
LanguageData.EndIt_Seppuku: {0} has cut open their stomach and is bleeding out.
LanguageData.EndIt_MercyKillConfirm: Are you sure you want {0} to put {1} out of their misery?\n\nThis cannot be undone.
LanguageData.EndIt_GunExecute_NoGun: {0} needs a gun or blade equipped
LanguageData.EndIt_GunExecute_Reserved: someone else is busy with them
LanguageData.EndIt_RouletteSurvived: {0} pulled the trigger {1} times and lived.
LanguageData.EndIt_Survived: {0} survived the attempt to end it.
LanguageData.EndIt_Settings_RequireInjury: Require the pawn to be downed or injured
LanguageData.EndIt_Settings_GunExecutions: Executioners with a gun shoot the prisoner instead of cutting
LanguageData.EndIt_Torture_GizmoDesc: Choose a prisoner, a torturer, a method, a reason and how long. The torturer carries the prisoner here, straps them in and gets to work.
LanguageData.EndIt_Torture_StopDesc: End the session now. What has been done to {0} so far still counts.
LanguageData.EndIt_Torture_StopBeforeDeathDesc: The torturer holds back near the limits and stops the session if the prisoner gets close to death: heavy blood loss, near drowning, a failing heart, deep hypothermia or very poor health. Without this, the prisoner may die.
LanguageData.EndIt_Torture_PickTorturer: Pick a torturer who can do violence and use their hands.
LanguageData.EndIt_Torture_NoPath: {0} can't reach the prisoner or the chair.
LanguageData.EndIt_Torture_Reserved: Someone else is busy with the prisoner or the chair.
LanguageData.EndIt_Torture_AlreadyTalked: {0} has already told you everything they know.
LanguageData.EndIt_Torture_NoIntel: {0} didn't break. Nothing useful came out of it (chance was {1}).
LanguageData.EndIt_Torture_IntelNothing: {0} broke, but had nothing you could act on right now.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureMethod_Beating_Desc: Punches to the body and face. Bruises, and now and then a cracked rib. Least effective for intel.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureMethod_Waterboarding_Desc: A cloth over the face and water poured over it in bursts. Causes near drowning without leaving wounds. Most effective for intel.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureMethod_Branding_Desc: A red-hot iron pressed to the arms, legs and chest. Burns that can scar.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureMethod_ElectricShock_Desc: Shocks from an electric prod: pain, spasms and a struggling heart, wearing off over about a day. Small burns where it touches.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureMethod_Thumbscrews_Desc: Fingers crushed in an iron vice. Badly crushed fingers can be lost for good.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureMethod_Cutting_Desc: Shallow knife cuts on the arms, legs and chest. They bleed, and can scar.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureMethod_FootWhipping_Desc: A cane across the soles of the feet. Very painful, little lasting damage beyond bruised feet.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureMethod_IceWater_Desc: Bucket after bucket of freezing water. Causes hypothermia, which fades once they're warm again.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureMethod_RussianRoulette_Desc: One bullet in the torturer's revolver, the cylinder spun once. The torturer holds it to the prisoner's head and pulls, then to their own, taking turns until the bullet comes up, at most six pulls. Whoever it hits takes a shot to the head. The torturer needs a revolver or magnum pistol. Best of all for intel.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureRoulette_Note: Russian roulette ignores the duration and the safety: it goes on until the bullet fires, and it can hit the torturer.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureRoulette_PrisonerShot: The revolver went off against {0}'s head. They're still alive.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureRoulette_PrisonerDied: The revolver went off against {0}'s head.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureRoulette_TorturerSurvived: {0} lost at their own game of Russian roulette, and survived the shot.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureRoulette_TorturerDied: {0} lost at their own game of Russian roulette.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureReason_Intel_Desc: At the end, a chance they break and talk, based on the torturer's Social skill, how long it went on and the method. If they do, you get a real opportunity on the world map, such as an enemy camp or a hidden item stash. Each prisoner only talks once.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureReason_BreakWill_Desc: Grinds down their resistance and will twice as fast, making them much easier to recruit or enslave.
LanguageData.EndIt_TortureReason_Fun_Desc: No questions asked. Bloodlust pawns love it and get recreation from it; everyone else just feels worse.
LanguageData.EndIt_Suicidal_ReasonRjw: Because of what was done to them.
LanguageData.EndIt_Suicidal_ReasonBrainwash: Because of what was done to their mind.
LanguageData.EndIt_Settings_SuicideBrainwash: Chance of a suicidal break after brainwashing: {0}
LanguageData.EndIt_Settings_SuicideRjw: Chance of a suicidal break after a forced encounter (Rim Job World): {0}
LanguageData.EndIt_Brainwash_GizmoDesc: Choose a prisoner or slave, who straps them in, and what to change in their mind.
LanguageData.EndIt_Brainwash_StopDesc: Switch it off and release {0}. Nothing changes in their mind.
LanguageData.EndIt_Brainwash_NoIdeology: Converting to an ideoligion needs the Ideology DLC (and not classic mode).
LanguageData.EndIt_Brainwash_RemoveLoyalty: Break their unwavering loyalty (makes them recruitable)
LanguageData.EndIt_Brainwash_NotLoyal: Their loyalty can't be broken: only unwaveringly loyal prisoners have any to break.
LanguageData.EndIt_Brainwash_Warning: Takes 4 hours with power. Afterwards they're catatonic for 5 hours, and there's a {0} chance they turn suicidal when they come out of it.
LanguageData.EndIt_Brainwash_PickOperator: Pick a colonist to strap them in.
LanguageData.EndIt_Brainwash_DoneLoyalty: Their unwavering loyalty is broken; they can be recruited.
